bio.text: Allison Russo, a Democrat, is a candidate for Ohio Secretary of State in 2026. According to her campaign website, she has served four terms in the Ohio House of Representatives and is its former Minority Leader.
The site says she entered the legislature in 2019 and, before that, spent more than 20 years working on health care policy, advising federal agencies and health systems.

The site says she holds a Doctor of Public Health in Health Policy from George Washington University and a Master of Public Health in Epidemiology from the University of Alabama at Birmingham, and lives in Upper Arlington.
